issues.on_page: Change in Payables (10,947) (p5: 'Change in Accrued Interest on Bonds')
issues.issue: An accrual change printed under Other Financing Sources (Uses); recorded as other_financing as printed, but it is really an accrued-interest adjustment, so it could go in adjustments[] instead.
Fiscal agent fees for SID warrants/bonds could be 'debt service interest' (which includes fees); same applies to detail[5] (detail_category could be 'debt interest and fees').

issues.on_page: State Motor Vehicle Tax Allocation 317 (pp4-5: 'State Motor Vehicle Taxes')
issues.issue: The schedules label it 'State Motor Vehicle Taxes', so it may be motor vehicle tax rather than pro-rate state aid. Same applies to detail[2] and detail[14].

issues.on_page: Schedules 1-2 print both GAAP-basis and budgetary-basis Actual columns
issues.issue: Extractor chose the budgetary-basis Actual column; defensible, but detail will not tie to the GAAP statement lines.
